# Medusa

> Medusa is a small programmable web crawler for Ruby.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/brutuscat/medusa-crawler/blob/main/README.rdoc): installation and usage.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/brutuscat/medusa-crawler/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): planned releases.
- [Source](https://github.com/brutuscat/medusa-crawler): source code.
- [RubyGems](https://rubygems.org/gems/medusa-crawler): published gem.

## Contributor guidance

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/brutuscat/medusa-crawler/blob/main/AGENTS.md): project goals, quality rules, safety constraints, and testing expectations.

Medusa performs HTTP crawling. Do not assume browser or JavaScript execution unless the documentation explicitly states otherwise.
